sentences.text: Researchers developed thin semiconductor channels connected directly to metallic-like electrodes without extra metal engineering, creating interfaces that allowed reliable electrical flow while maintaining flexibility without special contact adjustments.
These devices exhibited consistent synaptic behaviors even when physically deformed, a property the authors note could improve pattern recognition in artificial neural networks.
The authors suggest this approach offers a new way to combine atom-thin material properties with large-scale manufacturing for future computing.
